title: OFSS Bihar 11th Spot Admission 2026 Online Form
organization: Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS), Bihar
vacancyDetails: OFSS Bihar 11th class spot admission for remaining vacant seats in government and aided schools for the 2026 academic session.
qualification: Eligibility is based on the 10th class result / school selection norms and the latest OFSS Bihar admission rules for class 11.
ageLimit: As per OFSS Bihar 11th admission rules and school-wise admission norms.
applicationFee: Admission fee and processing fee as notified by OFSS Bihar / participating schools.
selectionProcess: merit / school allocation -> document verification -> final admission at allotted school
documentsRequired: Class 10 mark sheet, transfer certificate, passport-size photo, signature, category certificate if applicable, domicile certificate, income certificate if required, and other relevant school documents.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official OFSS Bihar portal
2. Open the class 11 spot admission section
3. Register/login and select the desired school and stream
4. Fill the application details and upload required documents
5. Submit the form and keep the confirmation page for further admission steps
shortDescription: OFSS Bihar 11th Spot Admission 2026 application status is last date extended. The final last date to submit the online application is 18-09-2026.
content:
OFSS Bihar has opened the 11th Spot Admission 2026 process for students seeking admission to class 11 in government and aided schools.

Application Status: Last date extended.

Last Date: 18-09-2026.

Students must complete the spot admission process through the official OFSS portal and follow document verification and school allotment steps as notified by the board.

Important Dates

  • Application status: Last Date Extend
  • Last date: 18-09-2026
  • Further process: As per OFSS officials / school notice

Documents Required

  • Class 10 marksheet
  • Photo, signature and ID proof
  • Category certificate if applicable
  • Domicile / school-specific certificates when required

Use the official OFSS Bihar website for the latest admission notice, seat status and verification updates before final submission.
editorNotes: Last date extended to 18-09-2026 as per the provided notice. Verify seat matrix and school-specific instructions on the official OFSS portal before submission.
importantInstructions: Complete the application before 18-09-2026 and keep documents ready for school verification and allotment.
